text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Hmm... It seems she changed her dietary menu. Perhaps she will be focusing on muscle reinforcement from now on?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: That senpai having Narazuke pickles with Western cuisine again today...? I see, so that's the character branding she's aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Royce, gathering data again~? Then check out Turbo too~!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Oh? But I just updated your ability matrix, didn't I? Your speed has been improving lately, after all!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Oooohhhh, really?! But today's Turbo is super amazing too~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I tune up every single day~! Right?! Pleeaaaseeee~!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...?! Throwing a tantrum mixed with wheedling... Has her calculated cuteness level risen...?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Looks like the personality matrix requires an update as well. Very well, show me what you've got!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yay!! Turbo's gonna show you her growth!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On a clear, sunny early afternoon. While out on a stroll for a change of pace—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Vroooom vroooooooom!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flap flap flap!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Startled by Twin Turbo's sudden appearance, the pigeons nearby fluttered away.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Phew... Impressive speed as always! But why are you in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Fufufu! When you get stronger, you test your skills, right?! That's why Turbo—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Wants a carrier pigeon!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna send a letter of challenge to Teio with a carrier pigeon! Cool, right~!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: They always get away, but today for sure—prepare yourself~!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Chasing pigeons every day... If so, your instantaneous agility must have improved too. Worth paying attention to.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Wait waaaait!! Let's 'overtrow' Teio together with Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Come oooon! Turbo will share her snacks with you every day!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Coo cooo! Be friends with Turbo! Coo coo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Watching Twin Turbo desperately chase after the pigeons, I found myself unable to look away. Seeing her never give up no matter how many times they escaped, without thinking, I—
choice_data_list: So close...! You'll definitely get it next time!
So close...! You'll definitely get it next time!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: That's right! Tame it this time for sure!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Nuooo, thanks! Turbo will do her best!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Gasp?! Even I got caught up in—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: To think her 'compelling lovable charm' has increased this dramatically... Not bad at all!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaay!! I caught ittttt!!

text_block_list.name: Pigeon
text_block_list.text: Coo-coo♪
choice_data_list: Congrats! It's completely taken a liking to you.
Congrats! It's completely taken a liking to you.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: A lovable charm effective even on pigeons...! As expected of you, Turbo-san!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ehem! When I tune up again, I'll let you know!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: *pant* *pant*... No good again today~. Tomorrow for sure, Turbo will totally winnn.
choice_data_list: Good work, I'll be cheering for you next time too.
Good work, I'll be cheering for you next time too.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Never giving up earnestly even after failure—at this rate, your 'compelling lovable charm' reaching SSS rank is right around the corner.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Com-lovable...? Triple...? What's that, does it mean Turbo is amazing??

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Yes. Thank you for inviting me along. It served as great reference for becoming a beloved horse girl!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: You're welcome! Once I catch a carrier pigeon, I'll let you know!
